name: Mikan
source:
Catgirl who came to repay the protagonist's altruism, no. 1.

She's always cheerful, always energetic, and never seen without a smile on her face. She always tries her best, but can be rather clumsy. However, her frequent blunders do nothing to hinder her resolve; she practically burns with motivation.

She is terribly fond of the protagonist for helping her out, and knows just how to butter him up when he least expects it.

Lime & Lemon are like family to her, and she acts rather akin to the youngest of the pack.

"Mikan's gonna do her best! So how's about a little head tousling, please♪"
